programmes.d: A fur trapper swears to settle the score after his partner leaves him for dead in an Indian fight.
A soldier and a civilian conspire to steal an Army payroll.
A scheming fighting manager sets up a dangerous boxing match.
An Army sergeant is accused of desertion and the theft of an Army payroll.
Kitty Russell, seeing Matt wounded again, closes the Long Branch and leaves Dodge City to become a partner with an old friend.
A poker-playing trailhand, Jud Sorrell, reluctantly finds himself looking after a 10-year-old Indian boy. (TV-PG)
A proud father goes to great efforts to make sure his worthless son will face death on the gallows like a brave man.
A bandit holds a preacher, the preacher's fiancée and another woman hostage while Doc Adams treats his wounds.
A drifter tries to give his friend a proper burial.
A cowboy vows revenge for the shooting of his friend, who was mistaken for a criminal.
Chester falls for a penniless seamstress when he sympathetically lends a helping hand to Lucy Damon and her young daughter. (TV-PG)
A rancher stoops to murder in an attempt to force his attentions on a woman who marries his nephew.
Drunken Circuit Judge Warfield, who is on the payroll of town boss John King, is forced by Dillon to hold an inquest into the death of a woman saloon owner.
Matt Dillon, disturbed over being forced to kill a prisoner who was trying to save his life, turns in his badge.
A timid bank clerk gains courage to live only when he believes he's going to die.
A pretty young girl from Boston proves more than a match for Marshal Matt Dillon when she sets out to meet her fiance - an Army officer.
Fleeing from both Matt Dillon and his double-crossed partners, outlaw Gristy Calhoun discovers that his survival in the badlands depends on an Indian woman.
Festus Haggen stirs up a mess of trouble when he takes a job digging up gossip for Dodge City's new newspaper.
Marshal Dillon, crossing the desert with prisoner Charlie Noon, is pursued by a band of Comanches.

In Matt's absence, deputy Newly O'Brien tracks down a wanted man, saves him from bounty hunters, and finally establishes his innocence.
A high-stakes match gives an aging, down-and-out pool player the chance to regain his self-respect.
Matt and a fellow marshal are ordered to quiet down a lawless town
Louie Pheeters is found intoxicated beside a dying man and, unable to remember what took place, is accused of murder.
An old-time con-man, dying of a heart condition, manages to help save Matt's life.
Kindly Ben Galt turns into a murderous troublemaker after he suffers a blow on the head. (TV-PG)
An outlaw who saved Matt Dillon's life 17 years ago takes advantage of the marshal to plot another crime. (TV-PG)
